android-actions|Floating action button.summary: A Plenix floating action button on Android is Material 3’s FloatingActionButton (small, standard and large) and ExtendedFloatingActionButton, kept native in behavior (ripple, elevation, TalkBack reads its label, it stays put while the content scrolls under it) and styled with the Plenix roles of the web FloatingActionButton: the action color with its content color for primary, the raised surface with the border and the content color for secondary, the Plenix control radii and DM Sans for the extended label. Its sizes are Material’s own (40, 56 and 96 dp), the same steps as the web component.

compose: enum class FabSize { Small, Standard, Large }
/** The Plenix floating action button: Material's FAB in the Plenix roles. One per screen. */
fun PlenixFab(icon: ImageVector, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit, size: FabSize = FabSize.Standard, secondary: Boolean = false) {
val icon = @Composable { Icon(icon, contentDescription = label, modifier = Modifier.size(if (size == FabSize.Large) PlenixIcon.iconSizeXl else PlenixIcon.iconSizeLg)) }
FabSize.Small -> SmallFloatingActionButton(onClick, shape = RoundedCornerShape(PlenixRadius.radiusControl8px), containerColor = container, contentColor = content) { icon() }
FabSize.Standard -> FloatingActionButton(onClick, shape = RoundedCornerShape(PlenixRadius.radiusControl12px), containerColor = container, contentColor = content) { icon() }
FabSize.Large -> LargeFloatingActionButton(onClick, shape = RoundedCornerShape(PlenixShape.shapeXl), containerColor = container, contentColor = content) { icon() }
fun PlenixExtendedFab(icon: ImageVector, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) =
ExtendedFloatingActionButton(onClick = onClick, icon = { Icon(icon, contentDescription = null) }, text = { Text(label, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold) },

views: /** Styles a Material FAB in the Plenix roles (light or dark from the configuration). One per screen. */
fun FloatingActionButton.plenix(dark: Boolean, secondary: Boolean = false) {
val container = if (secondary) PlenixColors.surfaceRaised else PlenixColors.actionPrimaryBackground
val content = if (secondary) PlenixColors.contentDefault else PlenixColors.actionPrimaryContent
val c = PlenixColors.actionPrimaryBackground; val t = PlenixColors.actionPrimaryContent
setTextColor((if (dark) t.dark else t.light).toArgb()); iconTint = textColors
